intro: Ezra tells how the Jewish people came home from exile in Babylon, and rebuilt.
Chapters one to six: the first return, and the rebuilding of the temple, despite opposition.
Chapters seven to ten: decades later, Ezra the priest arrives to teach God's law, and to call the people back to faithfulness.
Tradition holds that Ezra wrote it.
Listen for God moving the hearts of kings, and for Ezra, who prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD.

card.parts: Ch. 1–6: return and the temple rebuilt | Ch. 7–10: Ezra teaches the law
card.key: The foundation laid (3) · The temple finished (6) · Ezra's prayer (9)
